title: Claims Handler
description:
Reed is recruiting for a number of Claims Handler opportunities with a leading Bristol-based organisation in the insurance sector, conveniently located just a short walk from Temple Meads.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong customer service skills who enjoys helping people, is confident communicating over the phone and is looking to build a long-term career within the insurance industry. Previous insurance experience is not required, and we welcome applications from a wide range of backgrounds including customer service, retail, hospitality, contact centres, complaints handling, banking, financial services and administration.

Working Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:00pm (35 hours per week).

Hybrid Working: Office-based during training, with hybrid working introduced as confidence develops within the role.

Assessment Centre Dates
- Thursday 1st October, 9:00am-1:00pm
- Monday 5th October, 1:00pm-4:00pm

Start Date
- Monday 9th November

Full preparation and guidance will be provided ahead of the assessment centre.

The Role

As a Claims Handler, you'll manage legal expenses insurance claims from first notification through to conclusion. You'll investigate claims, review policy cover, assess information and evidence, communicate decisions and support customers throughout the claims journey.

This is a telephone-focused role, with much of your day spent speaking with customers. You'll be handling a mixture of routine enquiries and more challenging conversations, making empathy, resilience and strong communication skills essential.

About You

We're looking for people who can demonstrate:
- Previous customer service experience
- A confident and professional telephone manner
- Strong communication skills
- Empathy and resilience
- Attention to detail
- Good problem-solving ability
- A genuine desire to learn and develop a long-term career within insurance

Training & Progression

A comprehensive training programme is provided, including an initial two weeks of classroom-based learning followed by structured 10 weeks of coaching and support. This organisation is known for developing its people and offers clear progression opportunities into senior, technical and leadership positions, making it an excellent opportunity for someone looking to establish a successful career in the insurance sector.

Benefits
- £27,000 starting salary
- 35-hour working week
- Hybrid working following training
- 26 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays
- Additional "My Day" leave entitlement
- Option to buy additional holiday
- Pension matched up to 10%
- Health Cash Plan
- Excellent career progression opportunities

Recruitment Process

Successful applicants will attend an assessment centre consisting of a competency-based interview, claims assessment exercise and telephone role play. Offers will be made shortly afterwards for either the November or January intake.

If you're looking to build a long-term career within the insurance industry and want to join an organisation that invests heavily in training, development and progression, we'd love to hear from you.

Bristol

- Have an understanding of the client's business when chasing debts.
- Manage a portfolio of full-service factoring clients.

- Using call back sheets to ensure all calls are captured.
- Verifying debts on the system when chasing.
- Agreeing repayment plans where appropriate.
- Identifying accounts for legal action where appropriate.
- Dealing with customer queries - disapproving invoices if required.
- Tracing customer collections within the system.
- Setting up and maintaining client files for credit control purposes.

Experience:
- Experience of working within a credit control role, ideally within commercial finance.

Key Skills:
- Basic understanding of word/excel.
- Good communication skills - confidence to ask questions.
- Ability to adapt to varying workloads.
- Good time management skills.

Digital Marketing Executive

North Bristol £33,000-£36,000 per annum Office-based, 5 days per week

We're looking for a hungry, proactive and commercially minded Digital Marketing Executive to join an established and successful independent business in Bristol.

The role is ultimately about driving more visitors, increasing sales and helping the business grow through effective, engaging marketing. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of a broad mix of digital and traditional activity and see the direct impact of your work.

You'll be someone who is happy to research, teach yourself new skills and find solutions when you come across something you haven't done before. You'll have a solid grounding in marketing and digital, but we're open to someone whose experience is stronger in some areas than others and who is keen to develop.

We're looking for someone who is resourceful, self-motivated and confident working autonomously, who takes ownership, gets things done and understands that great marketing should deliver commercial results.

If you're excited by the opportunity to broaden your skills, contribute ideas and make a visible difference, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing
- Managing and developing website and e-commerce content
- Creating engaging social media and digital content
- Supporting SEO and paid digital activity
- Planning and delivering email marketing campaigns
- Supporting seasonal campaigns, promotions and events
- Using analytics and reporting to understand performance
- Helping to improve the customer journey and online experience
- Supporting traditional marketing activity including print, advertising and promotional materials
- Working with colleagues and external suppliers to deliver marketing activity

What We're Looking For

You'll ideally have experience or knowledge in some of the following:
- Digital marketing and social media
- Content creation
- SEO and website management
- E-commerce
- Email marketing
- Google Analytics and Google Search Console
- Google Ads
- Canva

You do not need to have experience in all of these areas. A strong marketing foundation, digital confidence and a willingness to learn are more important.

What's On Offer
- £33,000-£36,000 per annum, depending on experience
- A varied role with genuine ownership
- The opportunity to broaden and develop your digital marketing skills
- A supportive and collaborative working environment
- Generous holiday allowance
- A range of company benefits

If you're a self-motivated marketer who is curious, capable and keen to keep learning, we'd love to hear from you.

title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator (3-Month Contract)

Location: Education Sector Bristol BS16
Contract: 3 Months Fixed-Term Contract
Salary: Competitive temporary hourly rate

About the Role

We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established organisation within the education sector for an experienced HR Administrator to join their team on an initial 3-month contract.

This is a varied and fast-paced role providing both HR and general administrative support across multiple sites. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the employee lifecycle, maintaining accurate HR records, assisting with payroll administration, and ensuring compliance with safeguarding requirements.

Candidates must hold, or be willing to undergo, an Enhanced DBS check and be available to start a 3-month contract.

Key Responsibilities

HR Administration
- Maintain employee records and HR databases, ensuring information is accurate and up to date.
- Support payroll administration, including processing absence, overtime, expenses and contractual changes.
- Prepare employment contracts, amendments and associated documentation.
- Process starters, movers and leavers on HR systems.
- Monitor and record sickness absence and other leave, producing reports as required.
- Assist with absence management processes, including monitoring trigger points and issuing relevant documentation.
- Respond to routine HR queries from employees.
- Produce HR reports and management information relating to workforce data, compliance and absence trends.
- Support ongoing HR projects and initiatives.
- Maintain compliance records, including the Single Central Record and DBS documentation.

Administration Support
- Provide general administrative support to the wider organisation.
- Manage incoming calls, emails and correspondence.
- Prepare documents, reports and letters.
- Maintain filing systems and records.
- Order stationery and office supplies.
- Provide administrative support across sites when required.

About You

Essential Requirements
- Previous HR administration experience.
- Previous administration experience within a busy office environment.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Flexible approach and willingness to support across different sites when required.
- Enhanced DBS check (or willingness to obtain one).
- Experience working within an education or public sector environment.
- Knowledge of HR systems and databases.
- CIPD qualification or working towards CIPD.
- Experience maintaining safeguarding and compliance records.

What's on Offer
- Opportunity to join a supportive team within the education sector.
- Varied HR and administration responsibilities.
- Valuable experience within a busy and rewarding environment.
- Immediate start available for the right candidate.

If you have strong administration skills, HR experience and are available for an immediate 3-month contract, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Legal PA/Secretary - Corporate - Bristol
description:

Legal & Administrative Support
- Provide efficient administrative and legal support to corporate lawyers and fee earners.
- Manage competing workloads, prioritising tasks according to deadlines and client requirements.
- Assist with file opening, management, document production, filing, archiving and retention.
- Manage calls, emails, post and correspondence professionally.
- Draft letters, documents, bills and other correspondence using precedents and templates.
- Assist with basic legal processes, forms, documentation and funding arrangements.
- Arrange meetings, conference calls and appointments.
- Manage online portals, legal technology and business systems.
- Provide general administrative and document management support.

Client Service
- Communicate professionally with clients and external contacts by telephone, email and in person.
- Provide consistently high levels of client service and customer care.
- Build positive relationships with clients, colleagues, agents, referrers, experts and other solicitors.
- Respond promptly to enquiries and ensure appropriate follow-up.
- Represent the organisation in a professional and commercially aware manner.

Compliance & Confidentiality
- Follow internal policies, procedures and business processes.
- Maintain high standards of confidentiality, information security and data protection.
- Support file opening, client onboarding, AML checks, risk management and compliance procedures.
- Assist with file audits and ensure documentation meets required standards.
- Ensure work is completed accurately and in accordance with relevant legal and regulatory requirements.

Business Development & CRM
- Support business development, networking and marketing activities.
- Assist with meetings, events, presentations and client materials.
- Maintain accurate client and contact information within the CRM.
- Input and manage client, referral and relationship data.
- Support colleagues in using the CRM effectively.
- Identify opportunities to improve systems, processes and administrative workflows.

Teamwork & Continuous Improvement
- Build strong relationships across the Corporate team and wider organisation.
- Work collaboratively to ensure work is completed accurately and efficiently.

- Take ownership of small projects and administrative initiatives.

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- The ability to work independently and collaboratively.
- A proactive approach and willingness to identify process improvements.

What We're Looking For
We are looking for someone who takes pride in providing high-quality legal and administrative support and understands the importance of accuracy, confidentiality and excellent client service.
Corporate law experience would be advantageous, although candidates with strong Legal Assistant, Legal Secretary or professional services experience are encouraged to apply.
If you are an experienced Legal Assistant, Legal Secretary, Legal PA or professional services administrator looking for your next opportunity in Bristol, we would love to hear from you.

title: Peripatetic Service Coordinator - Mental Health
description:
Please note that the closing date for this post has been extended to 14th October to allow more time for applications.

We are looking for an experienced and compassionate leader to join our Mental Health Services as a Peripatetic Service Coordinator, supporting teams across Bristol and South Gloucestershire. This is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful difference to the lives of people with complex mental health needs while supporting and developing high-performing teams.

As a Service Coordinator, you will lead teams to support people with complex mental health needs to achieve their goals, build independence, and develop the skills and confidence needed to live fulfilling lives within their communities. You will help people build resilience, develop practical life skills, strengthen community connections, and take greater control of their future through person-centred support.

You will be an inspirational and supportive leader with excellent communication and listening skills, able to motivate, develop and empower colleagues to deliver outstanding support. You will have a strong understanding of person-centred practice and a commitment to promoting positive mental health, wellbeing and recovery-focused support.

You will ensure services operate safely, effectively and in line with relevant legislation, regulations and organisational standards, while evidencing positive outcomes for the people we support.

Key responsibilities include:
- Managing the day-to-day operation of services, including rota planning and resource allocation, to ensure people receive the right support at the right time.
- Supporting teams to co-produce and regularly review support plans, risk assessments and positive risk management strategies.
- Providing regular supervision, coaching and performance support to team members, while ensuring training and development needs are met.
- Contributing to referrals, assessments and service transition planning.
- Monitoring service budgets and expenditure in line with organisational expectations.
- Providing direct, hands-on support when required and leading by example in delivering high-quality care and support.

The successful candidate will:
- Demonstrate strong leadership skills, with experience of supervising, leading or coordinating a team.
- Be highly organised and able to prioritise competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
- Have experience supporting people with complex mental health needs and a sound understanding of recovery-focused practice.
- Be confident in responding to people who are experiencing acute mental illness, in dynamic risk management and developing escalation plans to ensure that people receive the support that they need.
- Have knowledge of mental health services, legislation and best practice, including experience of trauma-informed approaches.
- Be flexible to work across a seven-day service, including a variety of shift patterns as required.

In return, you will have the opportunity to lead dedicated teams, shape service delivery, and support people on their recovery journey within a values-driven organisation committed to learning, inclusion and continuous improvement.

At Milestones Trust we recognise that without the hard work, commitment and passion of our staff, we wouldn't be the charity that we are today. In return, we are committed to rewarding you with a competitive pay and benefits package including:
- 34 days' annual leave, including recognised public holidays
- Learning and development to support your career growth
- Nationally recognised qualifications, from entry level care to management
- Flexible working, with rotas provided in advance
- Occupational Sick Pay after two years, increasing with service
- Health Cash Plan after probation, offering at least £695 cashback for health treatments (dental, optical, therapies, maternity/paternity, prescriptions)
- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay
- Free enhanced DBS check
- Dayforce Wallet, giving you access to your earnings before payday
- Employee referral scheme with financial rewards
- Employee Assistance Programme from day one, offering confidential 24/7 support
- Company pension scheme to help grow your retirement savings

We pride ourselves with being able to offer staff opportunities to develop and progress their careers within the Trust.

title: Recruitment Administrator
description:
Talent Acquisition Administrator

Location: Bristol City Centre (50% Hybrid Working)
Salary: £30,000
Contract: 12 Month Fixed-Term Contract

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Talent Acquisition Administrator to join a busy Talent Acquisition team on a 12-month fixed-term contract. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous recruitment administration experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and delivering an exceptional candidate experience.

Supporting experienced hire recruitment across UK offices, you will work closely with Talent Acquisition Specialists, hiring managers and candidates to ensure the recruitment and onboarding process runs smoothly from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate interviews, assessments and recruitment activities across UK offices.
- Support the end-to-end recruitment and onboarding process for experienced hires.
- Arrange and track pre-employment screening and right-to-work checks.
- Coordinate new starter onboarding activities, including buddy allocations and IT equipment requests.
- Manage queries received through the Talent Acquisition mailbox and Workday Help portal.
- Maintain accurate and compliant recruitment and HR records.
- Assist with the preparation of recruitment reports and candidate data.
- Build effective working relationships with hiring managers, candidates and internal stakeholders.
- Support the delivery of a positive candidate and new joiner experience through high-quality administration and attention to detail.

Person Specification

Essential Skills & Experience
- Previous administrative experience within a recruitment, resourcing or talent acquisition function.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Desirable Skills & Experience
- Experience using an Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
- Experience using Workday.
- Knowledge of onboarding processes, pre-employment screening and right-to-work checks.
- Experience producing recruitment reports and maintaining candidate data.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of £30,000
- Hybrid working model (50% office-based)
- Annual bonus scheme
- Up to 25 days annual leave, increasing with service
- Holiday exchange scheme
- Private medical insurance
- Enhanced parental leave
- Comprehensive wellbeing and employee support benefits
- Commitment to diversity, inclusion and reasonable workplace adjustments

Ideal Background

This role would suit a Recruitment Administrator, Talent Acquisition Coordinator, HR Administrator, Resourcing Administrator or Recruitment Coordinator looking to join a collaborative and professional organisation with a strong focus on employee experience.

description:

Bristol

£30k-£35k

We're looking for a creative, hands-on Social Media & Content Executive to join a family-owned property business in Bristol.

This is a varied role where you'll take ownership of the company's social media and content, while supporting wider marketing activity designed to drive enquiries, strengthen the brand and raise the company's profile within the property market.

title: Antenatal Clinic Administrator
description: If you are passionate about making a difference and delivering a positive experience to women and families, we would love to hear from you! We are looking for an experienced administrator to join the Antenatal Clinic team in the Division of Women & Children's Health at Southmead Hospital. The role of the Clerical Administrator is to provide administrative support for the Antenatal Clinics to ensure the efficient running of the Maternity Service, and to provide a comprehensive reception and appointment booking service for all pregnant women attending North Bristol Trust (NBT). The Antenatal Clinic is a busy outpatient area, with multiple clinics running each day, from specialist obstetric and midwife-led clinics to emergency and routine ultrasound scans. The post-holder will be expected to understand the breadth of the service, and the importance of each related part. The main responsibilities of the role include receiving patients to clinic, booking both routine and complex Midwife and Obstetric appointments, communicating with patients, using the Trusts electronic patient record system, obtaining information, liaising with multi-professional teams, booking interpreters and other appropriate tasks such as obtaining information for audits. The post holder will also be expected to answer telephone enquiries from patients and other professionals, ensuring that calls are answered promptly and professionally. Due to the occasionally complex nature of booking appointments, the post holder will need to be able to manage long periods of concentration but also be able to manage frequent interruptions by telephone or personal interaction. For a more detailed job description, main responsibilities, and Person Specification, please refer to the job description document attached to this vacancy.

title: Medical Secretary/Administrator
description: Greenway Community Practice is delighted to offer a rare opportunity to join our friendly, supportive and well-established team as an Medical Secretary/ Administrator. This is an ideal opportunity for an organised, enthusiastic and motivated individual looking to develop their career within primary care. The successful candidate will provide high-quality administrative and medical secretarial support to our clinical and administrative teams, helping to ensure the smooth and efficient running of the practice. You will provide a varied range of administrative and medical secretarial support, including managing clinical correspondence and referrals, supporting clinicians, processing workflow and accurately read-coding relevant information into patients electronic healthcare records. You will also provide administrative support to our wider multidisciplinary team and liaise with healthcare professionals and other organisations as required. More than anything, we value your energy and outlook - because we believe a positive, motivated team is key to delivering outstanding care. If youre looking to be part of a fun, dynamic team that genuinely enjoys working together, wed love to hear from you. The successful candidate will provide a high-quality medical secretarial service, supporting GPs and clinicians with the efficient management of patient-related administrative processes. Duties will include preparing and processing clinical correspondence, referrals, reports and other medical documentation. The post holder will be responsible for processing and tracking referrals, investigations and hospital correspondence, liaising with secondary care providers and other healthcare professionals where appropriate. The role will also involve monitoring and actioning incoming correspondence, scanning and filing clinical documents, allocating tasks to the appropriate clinician or team member, and following up outstanding actions where required. The post holder will ensure that confidential patient information is handled appropriately and in accordance with practice policies, information governance requirements and data protection legislation. In addition, the successful candidate will carry out workflow processes and accurately read-code relevant information into patients electronic healthcare records, in accordance with the practices coding policy and agreed procedures. Attention to detail and an understanding of medical terminology will be essential to ensure that clinical information is recorded accurately and consistently. Secretarial Opening Incoming post, internal and external, date stamp and circulate as appropriate. Sending outgoing post, internal and external, as required Typing GP referral letters and general correspondence, using eRs Typing Agendas and Minutes as required General typing, such as posters, leaflets, protocols etc., as required. Liaise with various hospital departments/secretaries regarding patient appointments/results/letters etc. as required. Use ICE to obtain results/clinic letters/appointment details etc. as required. Deal with patient enquiries regarding hospital appointments etc. Maintain the Private Fees Account, keeping a record of requests, responses, and payments in Deal with requests from Solicitors/Insurance Companies/Employers for Medical Reports, PMA Reports, copies of records etc.; prepare documentation as required; liaise with GPs to ensure a response; complete and send off. Deal with requests from Insurance Companies or individual patients for medicals; book appointments and liaise with GPs; sendoff reports. Deal with sundry and private fees payments coming in; enter on Private Fees Account and prepare regularly for banking. Devise protocols for secretarial duties Monitor the practice NHS.net email inbox throughout the day. Review and action incoming emails promptly. Forward emails to the appropriate staff member when required. Add patient-related emails to Docman for processing and filing
